resolution: Fixed the empty Eventbus Review panel — a regression from my own req_2424 change. That change switched the popover from reading the always-populated state.history to reading the bus via since()/head(); but the bus starts EMPTY and only fills from edits dispatched after boarding (AppFrame baselines state.seq on mount specifically so a restored session's prior history is NOT re-emitted onto the durable log), and the in-process fallback log resets on every JS hot reload. Net: unless you'd just made a fresh recorded edit since the last load, the panel showed nothing — worse than before. Verified the plumbing is otherwise sound: ffi emit() loops back to JS subscribers synchronously, the AppFrame per-edit dispatch effect is intact, and the host binding is registered (needs the user's rebuild to go durable). Fix (EventBusPopover.tsx, self-contained): prefer the real bus when since() returns events, else render the session's local edit log (state.history) — so the review always reflects your edits and upgrades to the durable seq-ordered stream the moment events flow. Purely presentational: no seeding or mutation of the bus, robust whether or not the host round-trip is compiled into the running binary. The count pill and undoable/redo stay honest. Parses clean via esbuild transform; not shipped (live session). Sha 4c784660c.
